settings.text:
We Are Unique

HempLucid has been a leading provider of premium wellness products since 2016.

Chase Hudson, founder of HempLucid, had a life-changing experience in 2012 while working as a first responder. Responding to a call for an elderly terminal cancer patient, he encountered an emaciated woman, deeply distressed, and surrounded by over 50 prescription pill bottles.

Chase knew there had to be a better way to help people be truly healthy. This prompted him to seek a better solution, beginning his journey to develop CBD products in 2014. In 2016 he combined forces with co-founders Talyn Stratton, Saryn Stratton, and Nathan Beckham, to form HempLucid. The whole-plant formulations Chase first developed in 2014 are still the backbone of our full spectrum hemp lineup, refined batch after batch over the years. We’ve been producing cannabinoid-based health and wellness products ever since.

HempLucid's story is a journey of deep friendships evolving into a purpose-driven business. Even in our eighth year, we remain a tight-knit group making and selling USDA Organic CBD products. Over the years we’ve continually developed our offerings by utilizing functional mushrooms such as lion’s mane, reishi, and cordyceps, as well as using other functional herbs for many of our products. We believe in utilizing many healing modalities and tools like cold plunges, red light therapy, nutrition, exercise, meditation, and CBD. We believe a balanced health foundation leads to performing to the best of your ability.

settings.title: Quality
settings.answer: HempLucid is dedicated to creating the purest, highest quality CBD and wellness products available. Our medicinal hemp strain is grown to Organic standards in Colorado, USA from clones, not seeds. These consistent genetics have been cultivated and proven over the past decade. We have maintained USDA Organic Handler's certification since 2020.

settings.title: Education
settings.answer: We’re committed to continuous education about naturally improving life. We’re excited to learn new methods for achieving wellness, and driven by the goal of taking health to optimal levels through good diet, constructive habits, and balanced living.

settings.title: Self Work
settings.answer: We are responsible for putting effort into developing our minds, bodies, and spirits so that we become better able to serve and uplift others. Healing begins with us. We must “be the change” we wish to see in the world.

settings.title: Connection
settings.answer: We gain strength when we genuinely connect with self and others. As a community, we can help each other grow and heal through love, attention, intention, and inclusion. We value our relationships and the enlightened, empowered people that inspire us daily.

settings.title: Compassion
settings.answer: Living life, you’re bound to find yourself in a bit of struggle from time to time. This should help us remember that we ought to practice empathy because everybody goes through challenges. People are medicine, and we believe there is great value in striving to be part of the solution for somebody else.

settings.title: Revolution
settings.answer: We see an empowered humanity where people are consciously engaged in their health and inspire others to do the same. This paradigm shift has far-reaching influential effects as we more fully embody wellness and wholeness, and act in service of others. Engaged individuals can make a difference.

settings.title: Purpose Statement
settings.text: Our community celebrates taking authentic action to heal ourselves in harmony with nature.

settings.title: Mission Statement
settings.text: We create innovative products and insightful content that inspire our community to become well aware of their healing path.

settings.title: Vission Statement
settings.text: We envision a community co-creating a reality in which people are consciously engaged in the wellness of their mind, body, and spirit.

We are a group that cares about each other, and we help each other succeed in business and in life. Together, we are strong.

Our employee mental health program takes a holistic approach to well-being for mind, body, and soul. Along with an excellent “traditional” benefits package, HempLucid offers healing massage with expert body (and light) workers and quarterly clinical ketamine treatments for anxiety and depression.

“Our society is facing a mental health crisis… Offering ketamine treatments to our employees has shown incredible benefits for healing, positivity, and productivity in the work environment. We are in a new era. A new social contract is being formed between employees and employers, and businesses are being forced to take a look at the mental health of their employees. We’re working hard to get out ahead of it and take care of our people in a proactive way.”

—Chase Hudson, HempLucid CEO
